title: Israeli bonds, shekel fall as election leaves Netanyahu and others far short of majorities
summary_full: Exit polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's alliance and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc both well off the numbers needed to form a governing majority.
